ATTENTION RESIDENTS!!!! Icon City Management Fire and Life Safety America will be on the property February 29th, March 2nd, 2012 performing annual inspections on the Fire Sprinkler System. During these inspections, you may hear the bells/alarms going off. THIS IS ONLY A TEST. Please do not notify the office or the Fire Department. This procedure is a state law and has to be done on an annual basis. Having these inspections will ensure that the systems are working properly and will perform as designed in the event of an emergency. Fire and Life Safety America will also be entering the units to inspect the sprinkler heads and fire extinguishers inside the units. They will be entering every room in the apartment and this cannot be rescheduled for these are the only days they will be here. Please remember to have all pets put up and alarms off. Please contact the leasing office if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you for your cooperation.
